svg.title: velocitty — bytes from the PTY to pixels
svg.desc: The shell writes x, ESC [ 3 1 m, y and é to the PTY in two reads. The bytes land in a mirrored ring; a scanner cuts them into runs and holds the unfinished CSI until the second read; the VT sets a red pen, interns it as style 1 and writes cells; the renderer repaints the dirty row from a glyph atlas into a CPU framebuffer that is presented as one damaged strip. A second trace streams an OSC title around the ring through the stream buffer to the window title.

svg.text: velocitty — bytes from the PTY to pixels
Walkthrough derived from velocitty 2d5a1a4 source and its ring tests. Not a recording.

g.text: 1/23 read A: readSource copies 4 bytes from the PTY into the ring at head
2/23 scan cuts text x; ESC[3 has no final byte yet, so 3 bytes are held and tail stops at 1
3/23 this drain's run list: one text run whose 1-byte prefix is printable ASCII
4/23 drain() hands the runs to VtState through its Sink
5/23 printPlain writes x with the default pen, style 0 (frame 1 paints it)
6/23 read B: 5 more bytes arrive; head reaches offset 9
7/23 scan restarts at tail: the CSI is whole and parsed once, then text yé; tail = head
8/23 the reused run list now holds csi 31m and text yé
9/23 a CSI ending in m goes straight to csi.sgr: SGR 31 sets the pen to palette 1
10/23 penId() misses the memo and the map, so Styles.add appends the pen as id 1
11/23 text yé arrives; each cell this pen writes carries style id 1
12/23 printPlain writes y; printUtf8 decodes c3 a9 to U+00E9; row 0 is marked dirty
13/23 frame 2: renderSel repaints only rows whose dirty bit is set, background first
14/23 x and y come from the warmed ASCII table; é misses the glyph LRU
15/23 rasterizeAt draws é, the atlas packs it on a shelf, and the LRU keeps its slot
16/23 blitGlyph mixes coverage: x in #aaaaaa, y and é in #aa0000; dirty bits clear
17/23 Presenter copies only the damaged pixel rows, then presentRect shows them
18/23 title · read C: an OSC 0 title with no terminator yet lands at offset 9
19/23 title · scan finds no BEL or ST: openStream copies 8 bytes out and the ring is empty
20/23 title · read D goes straight to the stream buffer; BEL ends it, END returns to the ring
21/23 title · finishStream emits the OSC as a stream run, ahead of the ring's END
22/23 title · Osc.dispatch sets the title; END then prints red after é and dirties row 0
23/23 title · drainHost passes the new title to the window once per loop
gap: not traced: keys to PTY, kitty/sixel images, selection, scrollback reflow, fonts, config
gap: not traced: pressure-mode skipping, VT replies; Peak C internals are vendored
gap: bytes from circbuffer.zig tests (1080, 655) regrouped into reads; ids assume a fresh VT
